purpose: Prove a page-local CSS delivery path that modifies only page256 Elementor data and does not touch Hello Additional CSS or any other shared/global resource.

candidate_carrier.known_role: hero extras containing existing hero contact buttons, CTAs and fact row
candidate_carrier.reason: renders early on page256, is already a page-local legacy owner, and can be surgically edited through supported _elementor_data content/search + content/edit without full page save

historical_page_precondition.warning: Historical only. Fresh live baseline and fresh af260016 exact escaped snippet are mandatory before the probe.

remote_gates_before_probe: Normal scope handoff authorizes page256 and no parallel page264 write/QA ownership would be disrupted.
WPVibe is usable under the intended +5 account; target site connected; exact quota known; >=10 D11 calls remain after the whole probe/readback/rollback margin.
Load Elementor skill in the future usable session.
Fresh page256 bytes/SHA/JSON and ID35 state are reconciled.
Fresh content/search on meta post_id 256 / _elementor_data returns the exact current af260016 editor boundary; never reuse stale escaped bytes.

probe_payload.exact_intent: prepend one tiny style element immediately inside the af260016 editor content, before its existing hero-extra markup
probe_payload.note: The probe tests style-element preservation/sanitization, not visual parity.

execution: 1. content/search with a unique ASCII anchor inside af260016, such as af-hero-contact, and copy the returned escaped snippet verbatim.
2. Build the smallest match-once replacement that inserts the exact probe style element before the existing first hero-extra node. Do not reconstruct the full widget/editor value from memory.
3. POST content/edit on meta post_id 256 / _elementor_data once.
4. Immediately read page256 bytes/SHA/JSON and require valid JSON plus only the expected small size/hash change.
5. Fresh rendered page HTML check: require exactly one style#af-page256-parity-probe and verify the existing af260016 hero contact/CTA/fact markup is byte/content-equivalent and still rendered.
6. Browser/source-target visual spot check: require no visible layout change from the inert custom property.

7. If all checks pass, mark PAGE_LOCAL_STYLE_CARRIER_PROVEN. If the style tag is stripped, moved, escaped as text, duplicated, or causes any rendering/editor issue, immediately remove only the exact inserted style element via a fresh exact search/edit and mark FAIL.
success_criteria: its rule is active/retained rather than printed as text
all af260016 original content/links/text remain intact
no full Elementor save or global CSS write
failure_stop_conditions: content/edit returns no_match/multiple_matches or uncertain 429 outcome
af260016 content changes beyond the intended insertion
frontend renders duplicate style marker or visible artifact
rollback: Freshly search the exact rendered/saved style marker and remove only that style element with one match-once content/edit; re-read page bytes/SHA/JSON/rendered markup. Never restore an old whole _elementor_data blob.

after_success_only.next_step: Prepare a single page-local <style id='af-page256-parity'> containing only the dependency-safe currently-approved page256 CSS blocks, preserving their internal marker comments for block-level rollback/audit.
after_success_only.important: A successful carrier probe proves the delivery mechanism only. Every CSS block still needs its existing source/dependency/pseudo-owner/responsive preconditions before inclusion.

estimated_logical_wpvibe_actions: about 4-6 for search/write/readbacks plus 1-2 rollback calls reserved if probe fails; live quota is authoritative
